description: This file contains unit tests for functions related to language hint filtering and normalization in a diff viewer context. It uses the Vitest testing framework to verify behavior of 'filterSupportedLanguageHints' and 'normalizeDiffViewerPayloadLanguages'.

methods.name: filterSupportedLanguageHints
methods.description: Filters a list of language hints, keeping only supported ones, and falls back to 'text' for unsupported entries.

methods.name: normalizeDiffViewerPayloadLanguages
methods.description: Normalizes language hints and payloads in a diff viewer context, replacing invalid or stale language hints with 'text'.
